name: California Jack
summary: Two-player All Fours variant where the stock is face-up and players choose to win or lose tricks to draft desired cards.
rules_text: Use standard 52 card deck. Deal 6 cards to each player, one or three at a time. Place remainder face up as stock; top card's suit is trump. Non-dealer leads first trick. Second player must follow suit if able, else play a trump if able, else any card. A trick is won by the highest trump if any, otherwise by the highest card of the led suit if second player followed suit, otherwise by the leader. Winner leads next trick. Winner draws top exposed stock card, loser draws next card. Continue until stock is gone, then play out final 6 cards with same following rules but no drawing. Each deal awards 1 point each for High (Ace of trump taken), Low (Deuce of trump taken), Jack of trump taken, and Game (most pip value in tricks, where Tens=10, Aces=4, Kings=3, Queens=2, Jacks=1). First to 10 points wins, ties broken in order High, Low, Jack, Game.
rating_reason: Trick-taking variant, strategic replenishment, hidden information.
